2112648673012416978.en_summary: Elon Musk says $SPCX is targeting two Starship launches per week by end of 2027, putting SpaceX on pace for ~100 flights annually. That could translate into ~10,000 tons of annual launch capacity to support Starlink and future orbital AI infrastructure while driving costs lower.

ticker_notes.SPCX: Grok Bot may use most compute, expect 50m daily users in 6 months
